decisions.statement: The antiquity catalog arrives as an argument rather than as an imported table.
A record entry with a name is read for the acquired lore entries the entry states.
A record entry that is a bare number is that many lore entries acquired.
An antiquity the record says nothing about has no lore entries acquired.
How many lore entries an antiquity has is taken from the catalog.
An empty catalog answers an empty progress.

definition: how much antiquity lore an account has dug up, category by category
